title: Paris Stands Still

mainMystery.truth: In the Chronos Synchronisation Trial, a wrong reference time ran on the trial clocks from 3:00 to 4:00. The record of that hour and Émile's warning were taken out of the official archive.
mainMystery.culprit: Victor Delacroix had the records removed. Émile Moreau, the Clockmaker, planned the London case and tampered with clocks in Paris to lead the detective to them.
mainMystery.motive: Victor hid a failure that threatened his name and the trial. Émile wanted the hidden records found by evidence, not by his word.

finale: Paris did not lose an hour.
